chapters.reason: The paper explicitly introduces a switch adapter to dynamically select between System 1 and System 2 modes based on task complexity, which is the core mechanism of the FaST model.
The paper focuses on visual agents and multimodal reasoning, specifically addressing the challenge of adjusting model confidence and reasoning depth for visual tasks.
The paper frames the model as a 'visual agent' and focuses on improving the decision-making pipeline for real-world visual intelligence tasks.
